### Another Seven Days
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/another-seven-days
Passage: Genesis 8:10
Points:
- Noah released a raven and a dove to determine whether the floodwaters had receded enough to sustain life.
- The seven-day pattern between releasing the birds indicates Noah was faithfully observing the weekly Sabbath cycle.
- Noah maintained his devotion to God despite the noisy, foul, and cramped conditions inside the ark.
- Modern believers with comfortable, accessible church gatherings have little justification for neglecting corporate worship.

### Only Return
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-march-13-2020.html
Passage: Genesis 8:9
Points:
- Finding no resting place in a flooded world, the exhausted dove returned to the ark as her only shelter.
- Noah did not scold the wandering bird, but graciously extended his hand and pulled her safely inside.
- God offers that same gentle mercy to seeking sinners and weary wanderers who come to Him.
- People need not try to fix themselves first; Christ simply asks them to return as they are.
